name: Layered Splat Scheduling (Case I)
aliases: Layered splats with segmented objects scheduling
definition: A scheduling problem for layered splats with segmented objects, formulated as a precedence-constrained generalized assignment problem, which is NP-Hard.
summary: Layered Splat Scheduling (Case I) is a method for segmented 3D Gaussian splats that enables fine-grained selection of specific objects and quality layers to maximize visual utility under bandwidth constraints.
